article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (captured 2012-09-24, posted "3 days, 19 hours ago", so the exact date is not stated) announcing fan site giveaways run by FR.Zam, Wikia, Mystic Mayhem and Free Realms Insider. The prizes include new items from Sunstone Valley and SC (Sony Cash) codes or cards, and the post directs entrants to each site's rules and Terms of Service.
